scope: Seven approved Red-tab replacements. Rebound and Web Vault implemented; five remain pending.
free_exception: Snap Sweep remains the existing base opener
gate_contract: Native purchase bits13..19, original costs and dependencies retained. Existing purchases carry over.
balance_contract: Comparable role, total damage and commitment budget, verified against native same-enemy tests before release
shared_asset_constraint: Do not globally alter GroundAttack15 SCA/GMB/GAB used by free Snap Sweep; route purchased actions separately

entries.original_role: Grapple follow-up that pulls the enemy in and knocks them away
entries.proposal: One grapple kick followed by a short vulnerable player recoil
entries.tradeoff: More separation for Spider-Man; less enemy knockback and crowd disruption; no extra hit or automatic launch
entries.implementation_research: Purchase gate, contact timing, independent player/enemy displacement and collision

entries.original_role: Launch a grappled enemy while Spider-Man stays grounded
entries.proposal: Original-budget grapple launch with a short player follow into the air
entries.tradeoff: Aerial pursuit replaces grounded safety; no extra damage or launch height; shared air skills still require their own purchase
entries.implementation_research: Purchase gate, launch/air transition, resistance and ceiling/room collision

entries.original_role: Aerial approach followed by a quick combo
entries.proposal: Committed aerial fly-by kick, passing to the far side when space allows
entries.tradeoff: Repositioning replaces sustained target control; comparable total damage; no added targeting range or airtime reset
entries.implementation_research: Purchase gate, native aerial hit budget, target approach, far-side collision and repeat limits

entries.proposal: Compact advancing kick/strike combo with a focused finisher; retain pause-input family
entries.tradeoff: Forward pressure replaces coverage; comparable string duration and damage; no free launcher or rapid-kick extension
entries.implementation_research: Purchased combo branch, native hit/cancel budget, asset-sharing isolation from Snap Sweep

entries.original_role: Rapid-kick extension of the advanced Spider Dance combo
entries.proposal: Finite close-range kick flurry with an optional early retreat finish
entries.tradeoff: Early escape sacrifices remaining hits; full string stays near native damage budget; retreat grants no invulnerability
entries.implementation_research: Parent-combo dependency, extension purchase gate, finite hit cap, retreat collision

entries.proposal: Shift part of permanent speed benefit into one manual punish/recovery opportunity after a correctly timed evade
entries.tradeoff: Lower ordinary attack-speed benefit; conditional quicker normal-damage response; no auto-hit or increased invulnerability
entries.implementation_research: Native speed tier values, purchase flag, suit gate, genuine evade confirmation, counter window and normal hit handling

entries.proposal: Conditional flow after a clean string, purchased web hit or counter; native maximum-speed ceiling and one bounded hit-confirmed evade cancel
entries.tradeoff: Lose permanent maximum speed; gain conditional control; hit/whiff drops flow; no stacked damage or infinite refresh
entries.implementation_research: Native maximum speed and prerequisites, purchase flag, hit/whiff confirmation, existing cancel behavior, finite burst rules
